meta.name: Celebrity Master Chef - Tamil
meta.description: 12 celebrities with distinct personalities come together to compete in a series of exciting cooking challenges.With unexpected twists, drama, emotions and entertainment, they battle it out to become the ultimate Celebrity MasterChef.

videos.title: A Star-Studded Kitchen Awaits
videos.overview: Familiar faces enter the MasterChef kitchen as a brand-new season begins with exciting challenges, flavours and competition.

videos.title: A Kitchen Full Of Stars Awaits
videos.overview: Celebrity contestants enter the MasterChef kitchen, ready to take on fresh challenges and showcase their cooking skills.

videos.title: The 5-Course Showdown
videos.overview: Teamwork and strategy take center stage as the contestants compete to deliver an impressive 5-course meal for the judges.

videos.title: Mystery Ingredient Elimination Challenge
videos.overview: A mystery ingredient raises the stakes as contestants battle through a high-pressure elimination challenge to secure their place in the competition.

videos.title: Hero Vs Villain Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants must combine opposite ingredients and turn them into one delicious, balanced dish.

videos.title: Cook for Your Loved Ones - Part 1
videos.overview: Blindfolded contestants are surprised by an emotional reunion with their loved ones before taking on a special cooking challenge together.

videos.title: Cook For Your Loved Ones – Part 2
videos.overview: Continuing from the previous episode, the contestants prepare and present their dishes to their loved ones. The challenge celebrates family bonds, personal connections, and the emotions associated with cooking for the people who matter most.

videos.title: Dosa Challenge – Minor Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants must prepare the perfect dosa, accompanied by two chutneys and one podi.The challenge tests their precision, technique, consistency, and ability to deliver a well-balanced South Indian breakfast.

videos.title: Time vs Ingredient – Major Challenge
videos.overview: Mystery boxes, surprise ingredients and ticking clocks put contestants to the test. Who will avoid the elimination challenge?

videos.title: Fire Challenge – Elimination
videos.overview: Fiery ingredients take center stage as contestants battle to balance heat and flavour. Who will impress the judges and avoid elimination?

videos.title: Kida Virunthu
videos.overview: Diwali brings the Immunity Pin race as contestants face the Kida Virunthu Challenge, cooking meat dishes for a crucial advantage.

videos.title: Diwali Snacks Challenge Box
videos.overview: The contestants prepare a festive Diwali platter, while Chef Bhat recreates Samantha’s favourite dishes, adding a special touch to the celebration.

videos.title: Biryani Challenge
videos.overview: The contestants share their personal memories of biryani before taking on the Zeeba Biryani Challenge. Each contestant draws a hidden ingredient card and must prepare a biryani using Zeeba rice featuring the assigned ingredient, a side dish, and a raita. Only eight contestants will advance in the race, while three will lose their chance to compete for immunity.

videos.title: Colour Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants reveal one of four colours and are paired accordingly. Using ingredients from their colour-coded racks, they create individual dishes judged separately, with only six earning a spot in the Immunity Challenge while two miss out.

videos.title: Dessert Challenge
videos.overview: Six contestants recreate desserts with a creative twist to win the Immunity Pin. A heartfelt farewell for Samantha ends the week.

videos.title: Taste Of Tamilnadu
videos.overview: The contestants must recreate iconic signature dishes from different districts of Tamil Nadu. Each picks a scroll revealing a district and two famous dishes, chooses one, and assigns it to another contestant. The chain continues until all 11 contestants receive their cooking challenge, setting the stage for an exciting culinary battle.

videos.title: Kadal Kadantha Tamil Suvai
videos.overview: The judges introduce the Chola Trade Routes theme, highlighting the influence of Chola-era trade on global cultures and cuisines. Contestants select their workstations and reveal their secret ingredients, followed by a 10-minute Barter Window during which they can negotiate ingredient swaps. Based on the ingredients they hold, contestants are paired up.

videos.title: Parotta & Salna Challenge
videos.overview: A Parotta Master joins the contestants to share his industry experience and demonstrate how to prepare parottas. The judges then introduce the Sub Challenge, in which contestants must prepare different varieties of Parotta along with Salna within 45 minutes, with access to the support pantry. A table with 10 numbered cloches is revealed, each containing a different variety of Parotta.

videos.title: Team Relay Challenge
videos.overview: The winners of the Parotta Challenge become team captains as contestants pick their sides for a high-stakes relay challenge. Using ingredients rooted in India's ancient history, each team must create an international dish while communicating the recipe in just 15 seconds between turns. One team earns safety, while the other faces the Elimination Challenge.

videos.title: Cook Along With Chef Venkatesh Bhat!
videos.overview: Chef Venkatesh Bhat cooks four dishes as contestants race to replicate them in 60 minutes. Who will face elimination?

videos.title: One On One Challenge
videos.overview: A high stakes face-off begins as contestants pick rivals and ingredients, only to cook with their own choices. Who will earn the Black Apron?

videos.title: Mystery Box Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants create a sweet or savoury dish with four ingredients minimum and Zeeba Basmati Rice. Weakest efforts earn Black Aprons this round.

videos.title: Mini Challenge - Coconut Milk Challenge
videos.overview: The judges announce a race against time as contestants grate a whole coconut and extract fresh coconut milk while wearing gloves. They have 40 minutes to fill a 500 ml bottle. The first contestant to reach 500 ml wins, and all others must stop immediately. The amount extracted determines how much milk they can use, while the winner gains an advantage in the next round.

videos.title: Main Challenge - Coconut Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants face a coconut-themed challenge, using coconut-based ingredients and earned coconut milk to craft a standout dish.

videos.title: Chef Adka's Biscoff  Challenge
videos.overview: Chef Shreya’s Biscoff elimination challenge tests contestants’ precision as they recreate an edible coffee-inspired dessert with perfect detail.

videos.title: House Party Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants team up with friends for a House Party Challenge, where teamwork, strategy, and cooking skills are put to the test.

videos.title: Mini Challenge - Ullundhu Dal Snack Challenge
videos.overview: Using ullundhu dal as the key ingredient, contestants create gourmet snacks that showcase creativity, innovation and skill.

videos.title: Street Food To Fine Dining
videos.overview: Two contestants turn street food into fine-dining dishes. Surprise hurdles test skills, and the weaker dish faces elimination.

videos.title: Time Auction Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants bid cooking time from a shared 90-minute pool to win their preferred protein. With only their bid time to cook, every second counts.

videos.title: Team Service Challenge
videos.overview: Top 8 contestants reunite with former participants and, alongside judges, prepare a special feast for delivery partners in a Team Service Challenge.
